meta.title: dsh-notta
meta.description: Opens a notes panel in the left sidebar under Automation tasks. One vault at a time, defaulting to /Users/ruska/Documents/ob资料库, and the folder can be changed in the panel. Notes render with mdian and react-markdown using Obsidian formatting: wikilinks, embeds, callouts, highlights, tables, math, and Mermaid. Notes are read-only; .base files can gain a new view.
